name: Bodyweight Squat
description: A lower-body squat without external resistance.
instructions: Stand with feet approximately shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees in a comfortable range.
Return to the starting position with control.
techniqueCues: Use controlled movement within a comfortable range.

name: Push-up
description: A bodyweight pushing movement from the floor.
instructions: Begin in a supported plank position.
Bend the elbows to lower with control.
Press back to the starting position.
techniqueCues: Use controlled movement within a comfortable range.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
description: A standing elbow-flexion movement with a dumbbell in each hand.
startingPosition: Standing with arms beside the torso
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell held in each hand.
Bend the elbows while keeping the upper arms near the torso.
techniqueCues: Use controlled movement within a comfortable range.
